integrity: The claim is derived directly from the printed vector field by exact logarithmic averaging and linear algebra. Symbolic verification checks the algebra; bibliographic searches are evidence for comparison, not proof of uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The invariant-measure statement requires compact support strictly inside the biological cube so logarithmic observables are legitimate. Boundary-accumulating SRB measures are not claimed to satisfy the identity without additional log-integrability and zero-drift arguments. No existence, uniqueness, basin, or stability claim is made for a recurrent state.
title: Exact forcing-induced mean skew in the periodically forced May–Leonard system
